name: OBLIQUE V-UPS RIGHT
introduce:
Lie on your left side with your legs bent and slightly lifted. Keep your left arm stretched out in front of you. 

Put your right hand behind your ear. Lift your chest and legs up at the same time. 

Return to the starting position and repeat the exercise.

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Please don’t let your legs touch the floor.
Exhale as you raise up, and inhale as you lower down.
To get more of a challenge, please straighten your legs.
This exercise really works your obliques.
